notes: Rank = position among that state's entertainment + sports trends in the scan (blank = not trending there).
Interest by state: Free mode: the paid parts need a DataForSEO or SerpApi key.

Delhi circle: The Delhi LSA also serves NCR towns in Haryana (Gurugram, Faridabad) and Uttar Pradesh (Noida, Ghaziabad). Google Trends reports those under Haryana / Uttar Pradesh, so they are not counted here.
Haryana circle: Gurugram and Faridabad are in the Delhi LSA and Panchkula in the Punjab LSA; Google Trends' Haryana figure includes them.
Jammu & Kashmir circle: Google Trends has no separate Ladakh region; Ladakh searches sit inside Jammu and Kashmir.
Kolkata circle: Metro LSA inside West Bengal. Google Trends has no Kolkata-only region, so the West Bengal figure is shown for both the Kolkata and West Bengal circles.
Maharashtra circle: Mumbai is a separate metro LSA inside Maharashtra; the Maharashtra figure covers both circles.
Mumbai circle: Metro LSA inside Maharashtra. Google Trends has no Mumbai-only region, so the Maharashtra figure is shown for both the Mumbai and Maharashtra circles.
Punjab circle: Panchkula (Haryana) is also served by the Punjab LSA; Google Trends counts it under Haryana.
Tamil Nadu circle: Puducherry's Mahe (inside Kerala) and Yanam (inside Andhra Pradesh) enclaves are part of the UT; the DGT table lists Puducherry under Tamil Nadu without a district split.
Uttar Pradesh (East) circle: Uttar Pradesh is split East / West by district. Google Trends reports one Uttar Pradesh figure, so it is shown for both UP circles (it cannot be split).
Uttar Pradesh (West) circle: Uttar Pradesh is split East / West by district (and Noida / Ghaziabad are in the Delhi LSA). The single Uttar Pradesh figure is shown for both UP circles.
West Bengal circle: Kolkata is a separate metro LSA inside West Bengal; the West Bengal figure covers both circles.
